verdict.rationale: Discord is a chat tool, so a built-in no-code workflow builder is a fair question to ask. The evidence only shows developer building blocks: bots and apps, Gateway events, modals that collect form-like data, and webhooks. These require coding an app, and nothing shows a no-code builder for admins that runs on events, schedules, or form submissions.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can build no-code workflows triggered by events, schedules, or form submissions inside the chat tool
